blocks.title: Training & Service Culture
blocks.body: Team training should connect World of Hyatt participation with the Thompson Hotels service promise before opening or relaunch.

blocks.title: Ongoing Quality Review
blocks.body: Ongoing quality expectations preserve Thompson Hotels positioning after conversion. Align review timing, remediation paths, and responsibility split.

blocks.title: Service Model
blocks.body: Thompson Hotels service delivery must reflect the brand's positioning and guest expectations. The operator should demonstrate service-model capability specific to this brand tier and style rather than applying a generic platform service framework.

blocks.title: Technology & Systems
blocks.body: Thompson Hotels requires technology and systems integration consistent with Hyatt Hotels Corporation platform standards. Align PMS, channel management, loyalty integration, and revenue management system compatibility before launch.

blocks.title: Evaluation
blocks.body: Start with demand fit, product condition, and peer alternatives (Dream Hotels, Hyatt Centric, EDITION, W Hotels, Kimpton Hotels, and Hotel Indigo). Decide whether Thompson Hotels's design-led lifestyle brand with elevated F&B and cultural social energy is the right lane before detailed conversion capital is committed.

blocks.title: Conversion Design
blocks.body: Translate Thompson Hotels positioning into rooms, public space, service, and technology workstreams that match the intended design-led lifestyle brand with elevated F&B and cultural social energy. Sequence design, systems, and capital milestones with financing and operator decisions so conversion scope stays underwritable.

blocks.title: Pre-Opening
blocks.body: Coordinate World of Hyatt readiness, training, staffing, and commercial launch with product completion for Thompson Hotels. Clarify owner, operator, and brand responsibilities before opening so the guest promise is deliverable from day one. Keep Thompson Hotels product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the design-led lifestyle brand with elevated F&B and cultural social energy stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

blocks.title: Opening
blocks.body: Launch with the Thompson Hotels guest promise consistently expressed across service and channels while platform systems stabilize. Keep escalation paths clear for the first operating weeks and verify quality readiness against the intended design-led lifestyle brand with elevated F&B and cultural social energy.

blocks.title: Ramp-Up
blocks.body: Use early guest feedback and channel mix to refine delivery of the design-led lifestyle brand with elevated F&B and cultural social energy. Watch whether staffing and public-space programming actually support the intended Thompson Hotels promise, and adjust operator execution before assuming affiliation value is fully realized.

blocks.title: Ongoing
blocks.body: Maintain Thompson Hotels product discipline while meeting applicable platform quality and commercial obligations. Revisit capital and operator alignment as the hotel stabilizes so Thompson Hotels remains credible versus peer alternatives such as Dream Hotels. Keep Thompson Hotels product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the design-led lifestyle brand with elevated F&B and cultural social energy stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

blocks.title: What Owners Are Buying
blocks.body: Owners evaluating Thompson Hotels are buying a design-led lifestyle brand with elevated F&B and cultural social energy backed by Hyatt Hotels Corporation distribution and World of Hyatt. The practical case is Underwrite Thompson Hotels as design-led lifestyle with elevated F&B and cultural social energy—never as Dream nightlife-led identity, Centric explorer-light full-service, or EDITION/W ritual luxury-lifestyle copy..

blocks.title: Design-Led Urban Lifestyle With Elevated FAndB
blocks.body: Thompson fits owners delivering a design-forward lifestyle hotel where F&B, public space, and cultural energy are central to the guest stay—not Centric explorer-light or Dream nightlife-first framing.

blocks.title: Cultural Entertainment District Destination Hotels
blocks.body: Cultural and entertainment districts create Thompson value when destination appeal and social programming support premium lifestyle demand. Do not underwrite Indigo boutique generics or Centric location-only theses as substitutes.

blocks.title: Lifestyle Conversion Without Dream Or Edition Drift
blocks.body: Conversions work when the asset can carry Thompson’s design and F&B intensity. Value erodes if sponsors import Dream nightlife language, EDITION or W Hotels ritual luxury-lifestyle copy, or Kimpton interchangeable lifestyle paragraphs.

blocks.title: Operating Complexity For Experience-Led Assets
blocks.body: Thompson’s owner case assumes higher F&B and experience operating complexity than Centric. Staff and capital must match that intensity; do not underwrite as if it were a soft select-service lifestyle box.

blocks.title: Key Watchouts
blocks.body:
Do not underwrite Thompson Hotels like a lower-ladder sibling with thinner product capital.
Confirm fee / management exhibits before IC—Factory does not invent undisclosed rates.
World of Hyatt drives demand but adds loyalty chargebacks—model net contribution.
Operator capability must match brand QA intensity for this flag.

blocks.title: Owner Considerations
blocks.body: Sponsor capability, operator fit, and disclosure discipline matter more than flag prestige. Thompson Hotels application, royalty, marketing, loyalty, and PIP — Confirm current franchise disclosure / FDD exhibits for application, royalty, marketing, loyalty, and PIP. Distinguish historical FDD figures from the live agreement. Amounts are not staged without a verified disclosure.

blocks.title: Commercial Theme
blocks.body: Versus Hyatt Regency meetings full-service, Thompson is lifestyle/design-led; versus Hyatt Centric explorer lifestyle, Thompson often reads more design-hotel / destination F&B—confirm disclosure and standards.

blocks.title: Data & Analytics
blocks.body: Parent revenue and CRM analytics support Thompson Hotels where connected—property teams still own local competitive response.

blocks.title: International Demand
blocks.body: International feed depends on World of Hyatt awareness and source-market airlift—do not assume global portfolio strength equals this hotel's inbound mix.

blocks.title: Leisure & Destination
blocks.body: Leisure fit follows whether Thompson Hotels's product matches destination seasonality and amenity expectations.

blocks.title: Reputation & QA
blocks.body: Guest scores and brand QA affect ranking in World of Hyatt search and account eligibility—budget reputation management.

blocks.title: Sales & Catering
blocks.body: Group and catering contribution depends on meeting product and parent sales coverage for this flag—confirm before underwriting group-heavy IC.

blocks.title: Middle East & Africa
blocks.body: Confirm MEA openings/pipeline for Thompson Hotels—do not extrapolate from sibling flags.

blocks.title: Asia Pacific
blocks.body: Confirm APAC scale and growth posture for Thompson Hotels from parent disclosures.

blocks.title: Recent Momentum
blocks.body: Confirm recent Thompson Hotels openings and signings from Hyatt Hotels Corporation newsrooms—Factory does not invent opening lists.

blocks.title: Brand / Development Page
blocks.body: Public brand and development references for Thompson Hotels. Confirm current PDFs and fee exhibits with Hyatt Hotels Corporation development—do not treat this page as a fee schedule.

blocks.title: Loyalty Program Reference
blocks.body: Official World of Hyatt rules and tier charts — confirm earn/redeem before IC.

blocks.title: Dealality Insight
blocks.body: Thompson fits owners who can sustain design and destination F&B with World of Hyatt; fails when sponsors underwrite Hyatt Regency meetings economics or invent fee percentages.
